item.title: Jordyn Tyson: Not yet ready to practice
item.description:
Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Tyson (hamstring) is "progressing well" but isn't on track to return to practice this week, Jeff Nowak reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Quinshon Judkins: Viewed as day-to-day with ankle 'tweak'
item.description:
Browns head coach Todd Monken said that Judkins is considered day-to-day after sustaining a "tweak" to his ankle in Sunday's 17-12 loss to the Jets, and the running back hasn't been ruled out for a Week 6 game against the Ravens, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Dylan Sampson: Could return to practice this week
item.description:
Head coach Todd Monken said Monday that there is a "possibility" that the Browns open the 21-day practice window for Sampson (knee) this week, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Micah Parsons: Unlikely to return for Week 6
item.description:
Parsons (knee) isn't expected to return to practice this week ahead of the Packers' Week 6 game against the Cowboys on Sunday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jalen Coker: Could return for Week 6 vs. Philadelphia
item.description:
Head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Coker is "on track" to return from a one-game absence against the Eagles on Sunday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
